name: heavy-asset-warn
description: Warns when large images, videos or fonts are added to the project.

imageKb.title: Image limit (KB)
imageKb.description: Images bigger than this are reported.

videoKb.title: Video limit (KB)
videoKb.description: Videos bigger than this are reported.

fontKb.title: Font limit (KB)
fontKb.description: Fonts bigger than this are reported.

directories.title: Asset folders
directories.description: Comma-separated folder names. Files that cp, mv, curl or wget put inside one of them (at any depth) are checked; git add checks everything it stages.
